C1592.title: Personal Medical Device Communications Vulnerable to Multiple Network Attacks
C1592.summary: Research reveals that personal medical device (PMD) communications in modern smart health systems lack security features, allowing external attackers to access device communications and carry out man-in-the-middle attacks, replay attacks, false data injection, and denial-of-service attacks, thereby stealing sensitive health data or disrupting device functions and directly threatening patient safet

references.title: Heka: A Novel Intrusion Detection System for Attacks on Personal Medical Devices
